{reset();requestPlay();enterPeninsula();const n=peninsula,controls={keys:new Set(),motion:{forward:0,strafe:0},yaw:0,pitch:0};n.battle.army().forEach(a=>a.hp=0);n.battle.allies.forEach(a=>a.hp=0);n.menu();$('citychoices').children.find(b=>b.textContent.includes('지하철 2호선')).onclick();assert.equal(n.journey.kind,'rail');n.update(.1,controls);const doors=n.transit.platforms.get('seoul').doors;assert(Math.abs(doors[0].position.x)>1);for(let i=0;i<22;i++)n.update(.1,controls);assert.equal(Math.abs(doors[0].position.x),1);while(n.journey)n.update(.1,controls);const fleet=n.vehicles.fleet;fleet.filter(v=>v.hostile).forEach(v=>v.requested=false);n.vehicles.reset();n.vehicles.activate('seoul');for(let i=0;i<590;i++)n.vehicles.update(.1,controls,n.camera,n.position,true);assert.equal(fleet.filter(v=>v.hostile&&v.deployed).length,0);for(let i=0;i<15;i++)n.vehicles.update(.1,controls,n.camera,n.position,true);assert.equal(fleet.filter(v=>v.hostile&&v.deployed).length,1);for(let i=0;i<121;i++)n.vehicles.update(.1,controls,n.camera,n.position,true);assert.equal(fleet.filter(v=>v.hostile&&v.deployed).length,2);n.exit();console.log('PASS: local circular metro screen doors, first-minute deployment delay and one-at-a-time hostile equipment.');}
